high_level_overview.overview: The READACCT job is designed to read account data from a VSAM Key-Sequenced Data Set (KSDS) and extract its contents into multiple sequential output files for further processing. It runs the CBACT01C program, which produces three output datasets: a fixed-block compressed file, an array-structured file, and a variable-block file, all containing account master data from the CardDemo application. From a business perspective, this job serves as a data extraction utility that converts VSAM-stored account records into sequential flat files, likely to support reporting, batch processing, or data migration activities.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The JOB statement marks the beginning of a job and assigns it the name READACCT. This name is used to identify the job in the system and in job logs.

parameters.name: ACCT
parameters.description: The accounting information parameter passed as the first positional parameter on the JOB statement. It is used for billing and tracking purposes to associate the job with an account.

parameters.name: REGION
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of virtual storage (8 megabytes) available to the entire job for execution. This limits memory usage across all job steps.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Assigns the job to input job class A, which determines the job entry subsystem (JES) queue where the job will be placed and can influence scheduling priority and available resources.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class H for the job log and system messages. This determines where the job's message output (JES job log) is routed, such as to a specific output queue or sysout class.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies that the user whose user ID is stored in the symbolic variable &SYSUID (the submitting user) will receive a TSO notification message when the job completes, informing them of the job's completion status.

job_details.purpose: Pre-deletes three output datasets before the main processing step to ensure clean allocation. This step uses the do-nothing utility IEFBR14 to trigger dataset deletion via disposition processing.

Reads account records from the Account Master VSAM KSDS file and writes the data to three sequential output files: a fixed-block compressed output file, a fixed-block array output file, and a variable-block output file.
job_details.inputs: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS (ACCTFILE - VSAM KSDS account master file)
job_details.outputs: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.PSCOMP (OUTFILE - PS, FB, LRECL=107); AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.ARRYPS (ARRYFILE - PS, FB, LRECL=110); AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VBPS (VBRCFILE - PS, VB, LRECL=84); SYSOUT, SYSPRINT

data_operations.description: Pre-delete step using IEFBR14 to delete the compressed account data PS dataset if it exists, using MOD disposition with DELETE on normal and abnormal termination
Pre-delete step using IEFBR14 to delete the array PS dataset if it exists, using MOD disposition with DELETE on normal and abnormal termination
Pre-delete step using IEFBR14 to delete the variable block PS dataset if it exists, using MOD disposition with DELETE on normal and abnormal termination
Load library referenced as STEPLIB to load the CBACT01C program for execution
Program CBACT01C reads the account master VSAM KSDS file via DD name ACCTFILE as input source
Program CBACT01C writes output to a new fixed-block PS dataset via DD name OUTFILE with LRECL=107, cataloged on success and deleted on failure
Program CBACT01C writes array-format output to a new fixed-block PS dataset via DD name ARRYFILE with LRECL=110, cataloged on success and deleted on failure
Program CBACT01C writes variable-block output to a new VB PS dataset via DD name VBRCFILE with LRECL=84, cataloged on success and deleted on failure
